name: 29470-prefill-30ba3bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1), one engine, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, no all-to-all backend. One in-process vLLM engine driven by guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM sparse MoE: 48 layers, 128 experts top-8, ~30.5B parameters and ~3.3B active per token, FP8 block-quantized weights (~31 GB), 32 Q / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, 40960 positions -- all declared by the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 256 streams, 10% warmup and 10% cooldown, bounded at 1024 requests with a 900 s safety cap. Prefill is the load: every admitted request is 4096 prompt tokens against a per-step budget of 8192.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, fixed 4096 prompt tokens and 1 output token (min = max = mean), no prefix buckets, `request_format: plain` (raw text to /v1/completions, no chat template), `temperature: 0.0`, ignore_eos set by the backend. Not semantic: nothing reads the generated text.
purpose: A document-analysis service on one H100 taking 4096-token passages from 256 concurrent users, returning one-token verdicts.
launch:
# ENGINE: a source checkout of dd5d1ef780b5b73b9817e5dc8fe9b3e98a399e20
# (`git describe --tags --match v*` -> v0.11.1-513-gdd5d1ef780b5), named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# PINNED, AND BOTH LINES ARE LOAD-BEARING -- do not delete them as "the default". An in-process
# engine build resolves a usage context that is in NEITHER of vLLM's per-context default dicts, so
# unpinned these fall through to 2048 / 128, a different question about a 4096-token prompt.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: false

# The engine's own default, written out so the KV pool cannot drift with a future default.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
